title: CREATIVE FIELD WORK II
rpt_for_credit: This course is repeatable for 8 credits
description: Emphasizes intensive experiential learning studio art that focuses on site-based research and investigation. Collects or creates material inspired and informed by the interaction with the people and places associated with the area. Explores unique ecosystems consisting of rocky intertidal zones and old growth forests. Considers history of human interaction with the landscape. Practices leadership and mentorship for camp organization and best practices during site-based learning.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: ART 360.
A minimum grade of D- is required in ART 360.
recommendations: Art Core Studio, experience in one or more creative disciplines; willingness to adapt to working and spending significant time outdoors; critical thinking, leadership, and synthesis skills
clssnotes:
A field trip course in Lake County, OR. Meet at Playa Center for Art and Science 9/17-9/22.
